admin_settings.title: Administration & Document Numbering Format
admin_settings.subtitle: Configure automated numbering formats for official documents and company standard templates.
admin_settings.policy_card_desc: Configure the sequential numbering cycle for all official Altvira documents. Currently active: Monthly (2026 period). You can switch to Yearly to prepare for 2027 without modifying code.
admin_settings.mode_monthly_desc: Counter resets to 001 at the beginning of each month (YYYY-MM). Pattern: TYPE/ALT/YYYY/MM/ORDER3.
admin_settings.mode_yearly_desc: Counter runs throughout the full year and resets on January 1st. Standard pattern: ALT/TYPE/YYYY/MM/ORDER4 (4 digits).
admin_settings.sequences_card_desc: Manage prefix pattern, padding digits, and reset cycle per document type.
admin_settings.templates_card_desc: Configure default footnotes, payment terms, and standard document placeholders.

master_readonly.title: Master Data & System Controls (Read-Only Mode)
master_readonly.subtitle: Reference master data of vendors, clients, projects, and ledger controls for operational review.
master_readonly.controls_desc: High-level internal bookkeeping configuration and accounting standard compliance.
master_readonly.journal_lock_desc_active: Production Mode: Journal transactions are locked and cannot be edited/deleted.
master_readonly.journal_lock_desc_inactive: Testing Mode: Journal transactions can be freely edited and deleted.
master_readonly.journal_lock_toast_disabled: Journal lock disabled (Testing Mode Active: Transactions can be edited & deleted).
master_readonly.auto_close_desc_active: Automatic: GAAP/IFRS closing entries are posted automatically at period end.
master_readonly.auto_close_desc_inactive: Manual: Period closing and closing entries are processed manually by Treasurer.
master_readonly.auto_close_toast_enabled: Automated closing enabled. GAAP/IFRS closing entries will be posted automatically upon period close.
master_readonly.auto_close_toast_disabled: Automated closing disabled. Closing can be performed manually by Treasurer.
master_readonly.pph23_desc_active: Active: Displays 2% estimated PPh 23 withholding on printed client invoices.
master_readonly.pph23_desc_inactive: Inactive: Client invoices printed standard without PPh 23 estimate.
master_readonly.pph23_toast_enabled: PPh 23 estimate (2%) enabled on client invoices.
master_readonly.pph23_toast_disabled: PPh 23 estimate (2%) disabled on client invoices.
master_readonly.coa_card_desc: Read-only monitoring view for Super Admin.
master_readonly.projects_card_desc: Read-only monitoring view of client and internal projects.
master_readonly.vendors_card_desc: Read-only supplier directory for system oversight.
master_readonly.customers_card_desc: Read-only company client and customer database.
